annotations.title: Salary range position and merit increase

description: Salary range position and merit increase — Where a salary sits in its pay range, offline: midpoint, spread, compa-ratio, range penetration, quartile (or below/above range), gap to minimum and midpoint, hourly equivalents, a merit matrix scaled to your budget (rating 1-5 by quartile), a suggested increase for a given rating (lump sum when above max), and the effect of a proposed raise on compa-ratio and penetration. Params: salary (required) plus min and max, or mid with spread (percent, default 50); rating, budget=3.5, raise, hours=2080. Price: $0.003 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: finance_comp_band
